access: fresh isolated subscription thread per call; only allowlisted visible state; no tools/archive/opaque replay

power_plan.method: exact unconditional power of two-sided conditional McNemar test
power_plan.scope: independent task pairs; assumed discordance and effect, not empirical assurance

primary: complete-episode R minus K terminal success; exact two-sided paired test at alpha=0.05
secondary: all other arms, resources, stages, failures and history length are descriptive

selection.rule: one tier per family nearest known K rate 0.575; >=8 scheduled and >=7/8 observed per arm; every missing-score completion must satisfy K [0.25,0.85] and the frozen F bounds; K public mismatch, no capacity failures or global stop; ties choose lower tier
selection.validation_uncertainty: eight per cell is a minimum design gate, not proof that future success rates stay in range

spending: subscription only; no purchases or API fallback; every writer metered; actual charges unavailable
unknown_handling: trajectory-local unknown, no retry; source/account/isolation/accounting failures stop all admission
